item.title: BIG COUNTRY PREPS PLAYER OF THE WEEK: Sipe takes our weekly award with unbelievable shooting night
item.description: There are memorable shooting nights. Then there are shooting nights one is unlikely to ever forget. item.description: Entering Tuesday’s crosstown rivalry game off lopsided losses to open District 4-5A play, both the Abilene High and Cooper girls basketball teams were looking to break into the win column and get an early leg up in the race for the league’s fourth playoff spot. item.title: GAME STORY: No. 2 Gordon girls top No. 1 Eula in classic battle of unbeatens
item.description: EULA — Yes, it lived up to the hype. In fact, Tuesday’s showdown between the top-ranked Eula girls and No. 2 Gordon may have exceeded the expectations of some.
